aesthetic: Warm Broadsheet — a Swiss-grid editorial system rooted in warm paper stock, where every slide reads like a spread torn from a mid-century design journal: tight columns, deliberate white space, and restrained colour used as punctuation rather than decoration.
chromaticArc: Slides 1–10 are almost entirely Press White with cream touches; slides 11–20 introduce Newsprint Cream as a section bg, crossing into Ink Black on slides 13 and 21 as dark dividers; slides 22–32 pulse warm with Burnt Sienna accents at the deck's climax; slides 33–38 exhale back to Press White for a quiet close — light/dark crossings at slides 13, 21, and 31.
gridStrategy: Slides open title-only with varied anchor points (centred col 12, offset col 30, left-flush col 0); each successive section adds a body zone and shifts the title to a new quadrant, reaching 3-zone complexity (title + body + accent bar) at the climax around slides 28–32, then strips back to a single full-width zone for the closing sequence.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on 6 slides — the two dark section dividers, two mid-deck slides carrying block quotes or key statistics, and the penultimate closing slide — adding warmth and slowing the reader's pace at deliberate moments.

accentStrategy: Roughly 18 of 38 slides carry a thin 1px horizontal line (type: 'line') spanning 20–40 cols to divide the title zone from the body zone, or a narrow col-wide bar (span 2, rowSpan 8–12) placed at col 0 or col 58 in Burnt Sienna as a margin rule, echoing the gutter marks of broadsheet layout.
